<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>disable</Nullable>
    <AssemblyName>HolderClient</AssemblyName>
    <RootNamespace>HolderClient</RootNamespace>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- 二进制引用已构建的 RoomServer 依赖，禁止 ProjectReference，避免覆盖验证中的共享库产物。 -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <Reference Include="LiteNet">
      <HintPath>../../../Server/RoomServer/bin/Debug/net8.0/LiteNet.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>true</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="LiteSync">
      <HintPath>../../../Server/RoomServer/bin/Debug/net8.0/LiteSync.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>true</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="LiteSim">
      <HintPath>../../../Server/RoomServer/bin/Debug/net8.0/LiteSim.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>true</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="Google.Protobuf">
      <HintPath>../../../Server/RoomServer/bin/Debug/net8.0/Google.Protobuf.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>true</Private>
    </Reference>
    <Reference Include="Newtonsoft.Json">
      <HintPath>../../../Server/RoomServer/bin/Debug/net8.0/Newtonsoft.Json.dll</HintPath>
      <Private>true</Private>
    </Reference>
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

Files written. Need final answer with build/run commands. No execution. Mention 5 DLLs, expectedPlayers 4, 180s, stop file, local 5018 guard, secrets not output.

Potential compile issue: `int.TryParse(..., NumberStyles.None, ...)` with `port` out works. `StringContent` overload with Encoding+mediaType exists. `ReadString` method name shadows? No.

One issue: `transport.OnConnected += () => { ... client.SendJoin ... }` — client variable assigned. Good.

Another issue: `SecureEnvelopeOptions.FromBase64(envelopeKey)` returns options with default maxPayload 64KB; server may use different max payload? Default same likely.

Another: On reconnect, `CompleteRestore` called every 5ms while Phase == Restoring; first call transitions to Connected, so only once.

Another: In join loop if stop file appears, returns 0 without READY; main agent should know. Might be better to only check stop after READY? But if stale stop file exists, exits before READY, which is a clear signal. Document deleting stop file first.

Could there be a build warning about unused `System.Globalization`? Used. `System.Threading.Tasks` used. Fine.

Now return commands:

```
dotnet build AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/HolderClient.csproj -c Debug
```

Run with stop file:
```
dotnet run --project AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/HolderClient.csproj -c Debug -- --stop-file "<任务tmp>\holder.stop"
```
or direct exe:
```
& "AgentScripts\LobbyRoomFlow\HolderClient\bin\Debug\net8.0\HolderClient.exe" --stop-file "<任务tmp>\holder.stop"
```

Notes:
- Remove stale stop file before start.
- Program keeps room max 180s; create-room expectedPlayers=4, so Editor joining as 2nd does not auto-start.
- READY line only; failures `FAIL stage=... statusCode=...`.
- Reads only Assets/StreamingAssets/deploy.args; aborts unless meta.url local 5018.
- Holder is environment, not UI acceptance substitute.

No dotnet build executed per instruction. Good.

已写入且仅写入这两个文件：

- `AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/HolderClient.csproj`
- `AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/Program.cs`

实现要点：二进制引用 `LiteNet/LiteSync/LiteSim/Google.Protobuf/Newtonsoft.Json`（Debug 目录，无 ProjectReference）；真实 HTTP 游客登录 → `create-room`（`expectedPlayers=4`、`mapId=0`、`LiteNet.BuildHash.Value`）→ 真实 `KcpTransportClient + SecureEnvelopeClientTransport` → `RoomClient.SendJoin`；5ms 泵，最长 180 秒；`READY roomId=... playerId=...` 之外不输出票据/token/密钥，失败只输出阶段与 statusCode。信封密钥只从本次 `Assets/StreamingAssets/deploy.args` 的 `-envelope.key` 进程内读取，并要求 `-meta.url` 为本机 5018。

构建：

```powershell
dotnet build AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/HolderClient.csproj -c Debug
```

启动（主代理创建停止文件即优雅 Leave）：

```powershell
dotnet run --project AgentScripts/LobbyRoomFlow/HolderClient/HolderClient.csproj -c Debug -- --stop-file "<任务tmp>\holder.stop"
```

或直接运行产物：

```powershell
& "AgentScripts\LobbyRoomFlow\HolderClient\bin\Debug\net8.0\HolderClient.exe" --stop-file "<任务tmp>\holder.stop"
```

停止文件也可用环境变量 `LITE_HOLDER_STOP_FILE`；缺省为 `%TEMP%\lobby-holder.stop`。启动前请删除旧的停止文件，否则会在 Join 阶段直接退出且不打印 READY。Holder 只维持真实房间与真实玩家，不替代 `RunRoomFlowUi.RoomList` 的 UI 指针验收。
